meta.title: Columns window: Hide All / Show all, and column visibility persists

args.goal: On the current PR page, open the 👁️ Columns (N/N) control and verify the window lists all PR line-item table columns; use Hide All and verify the table hides all columns, use Show all and verify the columns return, hide one or more individual columns, navigate to another page or module, return to the same PR page, and verify only the chosen columns remain visible and the Columns button count reflects the visible columns.

steps.note: Performs and observes the complete PR column visibility and persistence workflow on screen.
Confirms the returned screen is the PR page with the Columns control available.
